# Forest Plumbing

> Forest Plumbing is a local HVAC company serving Forest, Lambton, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.
